title: Release Engineering meeting notes - 2026-10-06
content:
Attendees: Aisha Patel (chair), Miguel Torres, Lina Chen, Samir Gupta, Priya Nair, Ben Cho (SRE), Jo Park (QA)

Agenda:
- Weekly release train status (v1.18)
- Hotfix HF-327 review and rollout notes
- Changelog highlights for next release candidate
- Pending infra change (k8s node image) and risk assessment
- Action items & owners

Meeting notes / decisions:
1) Release train v1.18 status
- Current state: RC2 created on 2026-10-05. Candidate gating: unit + integration + smoke pass on 6/6 cloud regions except eu-west-2.
- Tests: smoke and basic perf passed in us-west-2 and eu-central; eu-west-2 showed intermittent 95p latency regression (~5-7%) across small subset of requests targeted at hosted-api-gpu-1 pool.
- Decision: Hold full production promote for 24h to investigate latency spike in eu-west-2. We will continue canary traffic at 10% for affected region only.
- Responsible: Miguel to own investigation (linked logs and perf traces), Samir to coordinate canary traffic adjustments.

2) Hotfix HF-327 (token-bucket refactor)
- Summary: A backported token-bucket bugfix to reduce queue starvation under burst load. Deployed to dedicated pools (reserved capacity) on 2026-10-05 at 02:10 UTC.
- Outcome: Improved throughput for sustained bursts. However, a config mismatch in the rolling script caused a brief restart of one Dedicated pool (region: ap-south-1) resulting in ~3m increased tail latency for some customers. No data loss.
- Postmortem action: add a pre-flight validation in rollout script to verify config schema.
- Owner: Priya to add validation and patch the rollout job by 2026-10-09 (PR: infra#432).

3) Changelog highlights (items to call out in release notes)
- infra: token-bucket hotfix (HF-327) - improved burst handling
- serving-runtime: kv cache eviction policy tuned to reduce memory churn under long prompt sessions (PR: serving#1189)
- console: rollout UI now shows per-route fallback metrics (product-ops asked to review wording)
- optimize: new batching suggestion UI (alpha) behind feature flag

4) Pending infra upgrade: k8s node image (ubuntu+CUDA stack)
- Schedule: planned 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-12 (staged across regions).
- Risk: potential image build failure observed in lab for latest GPU image when combined with kernel driver 540.x - triggers OOM on some quantized workloads.
- Mitigation: Ben and Lina to run extended stress/quantization tests on staging clusters and report by 2026-10-08. If fail, postpone regions with known sensitive models.

5) Blockers / outstanding issues
- Model image builder failing for select large 2B models on arm64 builder (error: OOM during layer merge). Blocker for private deployment artifact publish. Samir to open follow-up ticket and add cross-team tagging to infra and applied-ml.
- Nightly perf regression (eu-west-2) - root cause unknown. Hypothesis: kernel driver difference + client traffic pattern. Miguel to provide traces and correlate with CI artifacts.

6) Action items (owner - due)
- Miguel Torres - investigate eu-west-2 latency regression, produce timeline + initial hypothesis (due: 2026-10-07)
- Priya Nair - add pre-flight rollout validation to dedicated rollout job + PR (infra#435) (due: 2026-10-09)
- Ben Cho & Lina Chen - run extended quantization stress tests against new k8s node image in staging and share results (due: 2026-10-08)
- Samir Gupta - open ticket for arm64 image OOM and add reproduction steps (JIRA: REL-1258) (due: 2026-10-06)
- Aisha Patel - draft release notes focused section (changelog + customer-facing callouts) and circulate to product-ops (due: 2026-10-08)

Notes / context (informal):
- QA found an edge-case where caching TTLs cause slightly stale embeddings in Dedicated pools when a specific cache-priming sequence occurs. Not critical but should be listed under known issues in the release notes.
- We discussed making the release train cadence explicit in runbook: move to Tue/Thu RCs with canary window of 48h for large infra changes. Aisha to propose runbook change.

Next steps / next meeting:
- Follow-up sync scheduled: ad-hoc on 2026-10-07 (10:00 UTC) if Miguel finds a clear regression cause; otherwise weekly meeting on 2026-10-13.

Quick links / references:
- JIRA: REL-1254 (v1.18 rollout checklist), HF-327 (hotfix), REL-1258 (arm64 image OOM)
